## Checklist

- [ ] New behaviour has a test.
- [ ] Permission checks happen on the server, not only in the UI.
- [ ] README, docs or `.env.example` updated if behaviour or configuration changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased for anything users will notice.
